closure_scope: Bounded historical positive-outcome validation for Cuenca Zaña / Oyotún using official 2008 regional post-event evidence, the 14-Jan-2009 SENAMHI flood-inventory outcome and the official ANA hydrologic-unit geometry. This does not approve the hydrologic child contract or validate operational thresholds, current channel capacity, tributary routing or negative controls.

current_critical_reach_context.2019_reference_package: ANA transmitted four critical-point technical sheets for Oyotún.

negative_control_status.note: No dry or no-impact year is promoted from report absence. This bounded closeout is positive-outcome research validation only.

hydrometeorological_limitations.interpretation: The official outcome chain is strong enough for bounded historical positive validation, but not for deriving a rainfall-discharge activation rule.

forbidden_promotions: 2008 regional damage magnitude into an activation threshold
2009 affected-family count into a hydrologic threshold
2026 ANA critical-point design/model values into observed event truth
current critical-reach condition into 2008/2009 channel condition

closure.reason: Two independent official time slices support real historical Zaña/Oyotún flood impact: the 2008 regional post-event assessment documents river-rise/overflow consequences across Oyotún-Zaña and the 2009 SENAMHI inventory records an Oyotún overflow affecting seven families. The official ANA hydrologic-unit polygon provides a reproducible research spatial unit, while missing event-day rainfall/discharge and routing information are carried explicitly rather than fabricated.
does_not_authorize: approval of the lambayeque_zana_oyotun hydrologic child contract
treating Oyotún district as the basin boundary
